Beyond his own photography, Bob Kelley is active as a curator and collaborator — helping bring other artists' work to light in the Bay Area.

Memorial Exhibition  ·  Curator

Kevin Bean:
Geometry and Color

Curated by Bob Kelley  ·  Organized by Bill Samios

A memorial exhibition celebrating the life and work of painter Kevin Bean, a dear friend whose bold geometric abstractions brought joy and rigor in equal measure. Bob Kelley curated the show as a tribute to Bean's legacy and vision.
